name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-tutorial-theme-and-design
title: Theme and design for the Copilot canvas
shortDescription: A Copilot UX component with sample project cards that follows the Copilot light and dark themes and adapts to the inline and fullscreen display modes.
longDescription: The finished solution for the article Theme and design for the Copilot canvas. The DesignShowcase component shows sample project cards built with Fluent UI. It follows the Copilot light and dark themes, adapts its layout to the inline and fullscreen display modes and to the width of the canvas, and keeps the selected card when the display mode changes.
The component uses bundled sample data. It makes no network calls and requests no API permissions; the solution package is the only thing to deploy.
